def get_face_roi_from_image(image):
    faces_detected, gray = detect_face(image)
    if len(faces_detected) == 0:
        return None, gray
    (x, y, w, h) = faces_detected[0]
    face_roi = gray[y:y + h, x:x + w]
    face_roi = cv2.resize(face_roi, (200, 200))
    return face_roi, gray
